Site.name: Konstantin Konyushkin
Site.description: Frontend developer with a love for medieval history. Homepage and project collection.

HomePage.greeting: Hello, I’m a frontend developer with the soul of a medieval chronicler.

about.title: About
about.text: Konstantin writes code the way medieval craftsmen built cathedrals: patiently, with care for every detail, and for the love of the craft itself. React and TypeScript are his tools; small personal projects are his collection, gathered here like pieces in an armoury. When the editor is closed, he returns to the Middle Ages — to emperors, knights, and the stories told by coats of arms.

bio.title: Bio
bio.born: Born in Ulan-Ude (<ar>أولان أودي</ar>), the Russian Federation.
bio.university: Started studying information security at Moscow Power Engineering Institute (<ar>معهد موسكو للطاقة</ar>).
